newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hoya 96/97 group net profit seen up 38 pct--paper.
newsitem.headline: Hoya 96/97 group net profit seen up 38 pct--paper.

text.p: Hoya Corp is expected to post a record group net profit of about 15.3 billion yen for the year to March 31, 1997, up 38 percent from the previous year, a Japanese business daily said on Tuesday.
Nihon Keizai Shimbun said an upward trend is seen continuing in the current business year.
The paper said the expected increase for 1996/97 is due to robust demand for products related to personal computers and semiconductors.

The company's group sales for 1996/97 are expected to be more than 193 billion yen, up 16 percent from the previous year, and its parent sales are seen growing to about 130 billion yen, up 15 percent, the paper said.

It said the company's parent current profit for 1996/97 would be about 20 billion yen, up 19 percent from the previous year, and it is expected to pay an annual dividend of 23 yen for 1996/97, up two yen from 1995/96.
Hoya was not immediately available for comment.
